observations: Photo 0: top view of a white game console with an 'XBOX' logo printed on the top and a dotted vent grille over the lower half, with a black wireless controller lying on it.
Photo 1: front edge of the console showing a slim disc drive slot and the power button area; the black Xbox controller sits on top.
Photo 2: close view of the console corner with the dotted grille and the Xbox logo button on the front.
The white body, dotted top vent and front disc slot match the Xbox One S body; the words 'One S' and the storage size are not printed in any photo.
The console is never shown powered on; no screen, storage settings, power cable or HDMI cable are shown.
The controller looks used but intact; no cracks or missing parts visible on the console; light scuffs only.
Photos 1 and 2 carry a 'WILLIAMS GADGETS' dealer watermark; a faint watermark is also on photo 0.

identity.kind: game console with one wireless controller
read_from: photo 0 XBOX logo on the top
photos 0, 1 and 2 body: white case, dotted vent grille and front disc slot (photo 1) of the One S

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the Xbox logo; the body and disc slot in photos 0 to 2 match the One S with disc drive.
No storage settings screen or label under the console is shown; One S was also sold with 500GB.
One black Xbox wireless controller is shown in photos 0, 1 and 2.
Console is never shown powered on; installed digital games are tied to the seller's account and usually go when that account is removed.

risks.risk: Console does not power on, overheats, or has no HDMI picture
risks.proof: Video of the console booting to the home screen on a TV, with the power cable plugged in
Screenshot or photo of Settings, System, Storage on the TV, or the label under the console

risks.risk: Disc drive does not read discs
risks.proof: Video of a game disc being inserted and loading

risks.risk: Controller faulty (stick drift, buttons dead, does not pair)
risks.proof: Video of the controller navigating the home screen with all buttons and both sticks

risks.risk: Installed games are on the seller's account and leave with it; console may be locked to an account or banned
risks.proof: Video of the console after the seller's account is removed, showing the games list and online sign-in working
Photo of all items in the sale together: console, controller, power cable, HDMI cable

proof_requests: Video of the console booting on a TV and the controller working, with a handwritten note bearing today's date in shot
Photo of Settings, System, Storage showing the drive size
Photo of everything included in the sale, including the power cable
response.reason: Photos 0 to 2 show an Xbox One S with disc drive and one controller, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-working 500GB console with one controller and no games; a boot video and storage screen would raise it.
